changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE club_records ADD CONSTRAINT ck_club_financial_competitions CHECK (financial_competitions_hex IS NULL OR (kind='CLUB' AND financial_ledger_hex IS NOT NULL AND financial_ledger_clock IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(financial_competitions_hex) BETWEEN 80 AND 122960 AND MOD(LENGTH(financial_competitions_hex)-80,24)=0))

rollback.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_records WHERE financial_competitions_hex IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
ALTER TABLE club_records DROP CONSTRAINT ck_club_financial_competitions
